reviewMethod.statement: The full current PDP-1 development census is individually addressed by exact source selector and exact identity set. All 2,023 identities are semantically reviewed by row-level source review or shared normative cohort rules exercised over the entire set by focused definition tests. Generated counts alone are not completeness evidence. The 2026-10-11 current-cut review reconciles PXD-160 J-29 recovery semantics and the complete 79-record action wire result population, including the current/stale job-status distinction, against exact source selectors and pins the user-authorized PXD decision log.
reviewMethod.reviewAuthority: Internal PDP-1 semantic development review under user-delegated Media source-definition authority; no external owner acceptance, independent certification, runtime admission, or phase-status assertion is created by this artifact.

populationCoverage.reviewBasis: All 38 identity rows are reconciled against the 39 object definitions, source lineage, tenant scope and typed tuple rules; lane-A review carries per-object dispositions. One observation lacks canonical Media identity, one legacy transcription identity remains excluded.

All 13 value definitions are reviewed through exact rational-time, sample, pixel-center/boundary, dimension/unit, explicit loss and spatial-frame cohorts. Conversion remains declaration-only where algorithm/calibration is unselected.
All 13 current relationships resolve exact typed endpoint identities; PXD-140 preserves current 13 versus historical 11.
All 11 machine identities are reconciled to state adjudication and keep independent dimensions; no product lifecycle is inferred from UI/presentation state.

All 49 historical plus 6 additive owner transitions (55 total) have explicit machine/edge contracts; undeclared edges deny. Acceptance, execution, cancellation, known and unknown outcome remain distinct.
All 55 guard records bind exact transition/machine identities and typed facts with unknown-denies behavior.

All 166 facts have typed authority/origin or explicit non-authorizing dispositions; 164 edge facts have unique source-owned authority/evaluation records. `hold.unknown` is exclusivity-only and `holdCheckPass` is unbound-unused.
The single common fact is a separate definition-model input and cannot be promoted to trusted owner observation.
All 43 groups bind same-transition facts; every contradictory positive pair is tested and denied.

All 79 rows are checked against exact operation, role, actor scope, recursively closed request/result schemas, guards/effect/finality/recovery and unknown behavior. 78 are action-linked; the one operation-only retry-policy QUERY has actionRef:null and no UI identity.

All 148 identities partition as 97 operation intents, 49 local/session-only and 2 Shared identity handoffs. This is distinct from the historical 132 cross-interface binding snapshot. The exact 148 set is 147 `actions` plus one `ownerDefinedActions` record (`media.action.request-live-session-reconnect`), which is source-bound to `media.operation.capability.media-stream-session-reconnect`; the 147-row actionOperationDispositionInventory does not include this separately owner-defined row.

The exact selector `operations.ownerDefinedOperationContracts.records` contains 107 unique identities: 67 QUERY and 40 COMMAND. One hundred and one have direct requestSchema/resultSchema pairs; five use alternate owner wire/observation shapes; action-operation result/error/authority/recovery meaning may be inherited from a shared source profile. All 86 profile refs were checked against the exact owner-operation profile or capability-family registries. The 78 action-bound records join exact action/effect/finality/object/authority/profile sources; the retry-policy and J-29 recovery queries are explicit read-contract exceptions. The eleven current semantic reconciliations are individually recorded, including PXD-152 execution-reference lineage, PXD-155 retry-policy observation, PXD-157 typed-input alignment, and PXD-160 exact-session recovery; remaining rows are reviewed through common source profiles and task-specific crosswalks/tests. No claim of runtime admission is made. Current source deltas include PXD-154 wire/scalar corrections, request requiredness reconciliations, and the PXD-160 recovery query. The current source-cut delta additionally reviews media.operation.capability.media-speech-synthesis-dub and media.operation.fallback-selection.confirm.v1.

All 462 capability intents are reviewed against their exact stable P0 capabilityRef/sourceCapabilityRef, selected family profile/bounds, and effective input/output schema identities. This covers 448 canonical operation schemas plus 14 existing-operation bindings; counts are not treated as generated semantic proof.
All 462 bounds retain exact source binding and no fabricated defaults; four Agent Tool budget joins have positive/negative exact-reference tests.

All 129 current input schema identities are connected to exact capability-operation identities and reviewed for recursively closed typed request meaning, including the current wire/scalar corrections; the three current request requiredness reconciliations are cited in operations-current-source-review.json.

All 98 current output schema identities are connected to exact capability-operation identities and reviewed against the exact declared result meaning; acceptance, observation, final effect and unknown result remain distinct.

All 27 identities partition into 13 mapped proposals, 5 bounded-definition-only, 8 transport-only and 1 readiness read model; no unexplained identity remains. Route reachability does not imply operation equivalence or runtime admission.

All 43 identities partition into 17 mapped proposals, 4 owner-adapter-required, 8 transport-only, 10 provider-admin, 3 legacy-provider-profile-admin and 1 unimplemented; unresolved identity count is zero.

33 raw rows resolve as 30 public methods plus 3 excluded parser tokens. Every public method has a bounded operation/read or explicit transport/client/provider/legacy/not-admitted disposition; source review has zero exact-equivalence unknowns.
All 11 fixture identities crosswalk by exact action intent; only two carry direct operationRef; fixture execution is synthetic and production CLI stays NOT_ADMITTED.

All 4 handler identities resolve to closed authoring input/result/error definitions and exact capability budget/authority boundaries; transcript/OCR/model/media are untrusted data. Runtime and Shared admission are NOT_ADMITTED.
All 4 authoring contracts bind one-to-one to observed handlers and owner operation/bounds meaning; no execution reachability is implied.

All 9 publisher/event identities distinguish append acceptance from consumer effect and retain exact event/schema/resource/correlation/dedup/order/privacy/unknown meaning. PXD-156 qualifies at-least-once only as a future conditional Event Plane design target: there is no current delivery guarantee, no blind retry, and UNKNOWN remains pending reconciliation. Outbox/replay/durable delivery remain NOT_ADMITTED.
All 15 client notifications remain distinct from the 9 canonical publisher events; local projection does not assert owner event or durable delivery.

supplementaryReviews.meaning: Exact TypeScript export/schema source roles remain bound; this source-owned census is reviewed separately from gate identity IDs.

Spatial declaration, frame descriptor and axis-direction objects are closed. Exact registered frame/plan/loss values are checked, and success returns DECLARED_NOT_APPLIED only; no transform/calibration/qualification is claimed.

The classifier requires a closed hold assessment for the expected tenant/object/version and an exact host CURRENT_AT_DECISION_BOUNDARY receipt whose decision boundary and hold read authority/version equal that assessment. RELEASED requires nonempty holdRefs; NOT_APPLICABLE requires none; UNKNOWN denies, ACTIVE blocks. The observation oracle checks exact expected authority/version, issuer, purpose, time validity and subject. Receipt currentness is a trusted host assertion in this definition-only oracle, not a runtime authenticity claim.

supplementaryReviews.meaning: The wrapper action keeps its exact existing wrapper identity and does not select a target by default. It requires an explicitly selected COMMAND target resolved against current operation/capability/version/schema definitions, with the target request schema separate from the wrapper request and the target result schema separate from the wrapper receipt. The wrapper receipt records only the wrapper-level request/acceptance; it cannot satisfy or substitute for the selected target operation result. QUERY, workflow, ambiguous, unknown, recursive, stale, or unresolved-schema targets are rejected by the source definition. This is a PDP-1 operation definition review; no transport or runtime behavior is established.

decisionReconciliations.meaning: The source-lineage action/capability crosswalk maps to the exact definition-only QUERY. The accepted logical contract permits a resolved opaque execution reference only to identify exactly one caller-scoped ProcessingJob or JobAttempt; MediaRun is excluded. Unresolved results are non-disclosing UNKNOWN, and transport/runtime remain NOT_ADMITTED.

The four evidenceRefs[]/destinationOptions[] wire items use only the owner-supported non-empty opaque-string syntax (type:string, minLength:1), preserving array cardinalities and adding no uniqueness, URI, character-class, or maximum-length constraints. Scalar-map and scalar-record validators stay identical; the iana-media-type scalar-record projection matches its existing canonical validator and retains the 3-to-127 bounds and media-type grammar.

retryBudgetAvailable is synthetic DEFINITION_MODEL_INPUT only for evaluator fixtures. Its normative meaning is a BOUNDED_CHECK_OBSERVATION from the typed current retry-policy read. Eligibility requires RETRYABLE, DEFINITIVE_NO_EFFECT or DEFINITIVE_RETRYABLE_FAILURE, and retriesRemaining > 0. Only media-job/T03 RETRY_PENDING→RUNNING uses retry eligibility; RETRY_PENDING→CANCELLED, FAILED, and OUTCOME_UNKNOWN require exact current target-state observations. Cancellation observation is not a command, failure requires exact terminal failure observation, and UNKNOWN stays unresolved and never authorizes replay. No runtime read, dispatch, reservation, or retry execution is admitted.

Conditional at-least-once delivery is only a future Event Plane design target after safe reconciliation is allowed by its published contract. There is no current delivery guarantee; automatic append retry is forbidden while reconciliation is pending, and UNKNOWN remains pending reconciliation. No outbox, durable delivery, dependency admission, or runtime behavior is claimed.
